# Cabinet build photos

Photos and line sketches of one cabinet being built, in step order: cutting
the window, marking out, test holes, the bare underside, a dry fit, the lamp
bench test, the harness, the power supply, the fitted underside, a dry run, a
play test, the LCDs and the finished cabinet. Each step comes as a photo
(`NN-<step>-1120.jpg`) and a sketch at two widths (`NN-<step>-sketch-560.png`,
`-sketch-1120.png`).

A build write-up that uses them, with new wiring diagrams, is coming. Until
then, [CABINET.md](../CABINET.md#parts-and-wiring) lists the parts the engine
expects.
